locations.rationale: Explicit named import binding for the declared Greeter class; bindings are optional under the declared reference policy.
Constructor reference in new Greeter(DEFAULT_TITLE) resolves through the named import to the declared class.
Constructor reference in createGreeter resolves directly to the Greeter class declared in the same module.

records.rationale: The complete fixture contains two required constructor references to Greeter and one optional explicit import binding. The CommonJS files contain no Greeter identifier candidates. The declaration token itself is not a usage. Sorting the required locations by URI and then position selects the app.js constructor reference as definitionUsage.
